evidence.claim: In FixedTermLoanHooks, when the queueWithdrawal hook is enabled but withdrawalRequiresAccess is false, onQueueWithdrawal skips the isKnownLender/credential check, so an account without credentials (e.g. a second address a lender transferred tokens to) can queue a withdrawal and avoid sanctions escrow.

missing.item: Demonstration that the described path yields a sanctions-evasion benefit that is not already available to any token holder
